snippet.title: Kid Pilot: Part 1
snippet.description:
Title: Kid Pilot
Release Date: 1998
Developer: Knowledge Adventure
OS: Windows 95/98
Emulation: Win 7 using VMWare Workstation Pro
Description: Kid pilot is a Knowledge Adventure game which puts kids in the pilot's seat to fly
around the United states. 

Part 1: Introduction, Menu, St. Louis, Cape Canaveral, Atlanta
